title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
description: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.

key_facts.FEATURING: The highest pool in the world

amenities: Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world

faqs.q: What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
faqs.a: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.

faqs.q: What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
faqs.a: The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.

faqs.q: When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
faqs.a: The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.

faqs.q: Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
faqs.a: The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.

faqs.q: Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
faqs.a: Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.

faqs.q: What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
faqs.a: The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

faqs.q: What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
faqs.a: Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.

faqs.q: Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
faqs.a: The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.

faqs.q: How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
faqs.a: It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.

faqs.q: How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
faqs.a: Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

faqs.q: What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.a: Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.

faqs.q: Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.a: The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.

faqs.q: What unit types and sizes are available?
faqs.a: The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.

faqs.q: What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
faqs.a: Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.

faqs.q: What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
faqs.a: The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.

faqs.q: When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
faqs.a: Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.

faqs.q: Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.a: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.

faqs.q: What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
faqs.a: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

faqs.q: Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
faqs.a: Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.

faqs.q: How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
faqs.a: Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.
